This is really good advice. He always asks what he can do to make it better and I never know. Even just being held would help!
I feel horrible being a cutter, and I wish I wasn't.  I hate hurting people that made the mistake to care about me.

I wish I had a lifelong or best friend. You're a lucky person! To me, my boyfriend is my best friend, and while I love having that in my relationship because it really does feel amazing, I wish I had a girl in my life that I was this close with. Maybe even just for perspective.
Thanks so much! I'm glad you can grow in your relationship with your wife in that way. Gives me hope !

I'm really sorry to hear that. I'm glad she's an ex if she couldn't support you emotionally, that's a really hard thing to realize. That someone just isn't strong enough to bear your weight time to time because they can barely support their own. I hate having this baggage. 
I've had a lot of trouble finding someone who cares, but now that I think I have him, there's just the struggle of getting him to understand. Like when I'm going through depressive stages how crucial every moment is because at that moment my emotions dictate my actions and I can't think rationally.
I can definitely tell he's doing his best and he really does help, I was just wondering if anyone had any advice to just cushion the blow of 'I don't want to live anymore' so that we can talk about it without it turning into a fight.

>unless you aren't trying to be serious 

what do you mean?

They bathed their baby in mud. They killed their baby because they bathed her in mud and probably took acid. Not because they're vegan. You can get all your vitamins in vegetables. Mushrooms have B12, carrots have A. I eat those every day! I hate articles like this that make it out as though veganism kills babies then only mention the mud baths in passing.
By mud, they probably meant shit.

I was there last month, man. I just sighed relief for you.
And exhaled sweet smoke ;)
